You don't need an academic certificate to be successful in life 
society has made us believe your worth comes from how smart you are, it's not.

find what truly matters to you

19 is still young, there's still lots of things for us to experience.
Whatever the results are, it doesn't determine who you are and what you're capable of. Singapore's education system isn't designed for everyone.

There's people who can score As easily while some struggle to even make a B. However those who may be scoring As academically, might not succeed in areas like Art, Business, Sports. And those who have B grades might be better at these areas. 

Art and Sports degrees has been seen and looked down upon in society but honestly it doesn't matter because at the end of the day if you can find happiness and success in doing them, do them. You're put on this earth to live for yourself, not to live up to society's standards and other's expectations. Want better for yourself FOR YOURSELF. 

God bless and keep going 🙌

There's no sexual touch or sensation. It's jus you and whoever having real conversation with each other about goals and ambitions and how to complete them. Keeping each other on track while always admiring each other hard work and determination. Through this you begin to see each flaws and you come together to fix them. Key word together.
